G4_metadata.scope: all irreducible 7-state Metzler graphs without directed 2- or 3-cycles, not unrestricted PH7

RS_metadata.compactification: y=s/(1-s), gam=g/(1-g), times (1-s)^deg_y (1-g)^deg_gam; tau kept on [0,1]
RS_metadata.selectors: Abar<=0: all Bernstein coefficients <=0; Dbar<=0: all <=0; f1-4<0: all <0
RS_metadata.split_axis: path depth modulo 3 (0=s,1=tau,2=g); bit 0=lower half, 1=upper half
RS_metadata.variables: y=alpha1 in (0,inf), tau in [0,1] with alpha2=(3/8)*tau*y^2, gam=beta1-y/2 in [0,inf)

domains.G4_zero_faces: u_i=0 faces are NOT needed by f159 and NOT part of the f129 assertion; any statement about them below is a separately labelled reviewer computation (supp scope), not inferred from metadata
domains.f129_asserted_G4: girth-4 disposition: strictly positive compactified polynomial on the open cube, i.e. all six POSITIVE rates (nonnegative Bernstein coefficients + strictly positive leaf vertices inside the open cube)
domains.f159_needed_G4: Qpol>0 and Hpol>0 on the OPEN positive orthant (0,inf)^6 only (Lemma C rates are positive: escape rates in the no-2-cycle text, eigenvalues of -S in the main text); compactified: x in (0,1)^6
domains.f159_needed_RS: no point with y>0, tau in (0,1], gam>=0 has Abar>0, Dbar>0, f1-4>=0; compactified s in (0,1), tau in (0,1], g in [0,1); needed faces tau=1, g=0 checked separately; certificate covers the closed cube [0,1]^3
